paragraphs.text: Chondeah (sometimes spelled Chondaeh ), was a young woman from the Kingdom of Shikar who was determined to be the most powerful wizard in the kingdom.

Condeah was trained by the Shikaran Sages to become powerful enough to summon a Scarzam Dragon for Sol'Kanar the Swamp King on the Date of Tribute . She fell in love with Jinno Terimund , who was killed by Khonian arrows after discovering their treacherous plans to control the dragon rather than giving it to Sol’Kanar. After fifteen years, she allied with Gydolien Mor from the Kingdom of Khone , and the dragon was summoned. However, the dragon was ridden by none other than Sivitri Scarzam herself, who recognized Sol'Kanar as the source of the poppy that had killed her dragons years ago. Sivitri started attacking Sol'Kanar until Gydolien forced both dragon and rider back through the portal the two sorceresses had created. In a rage, Sol’Kanar destroyed the Kingdom of Khone, apparently under the impression it was Gydolien who had set him up. Chondaeh was received as a hero by her people, and Shikar began to return to its former glory.
